global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its broth a rich, golden-orange hue. Toppings—boiled egg, butter, chopped green onions, and tomato—arrange in colorful sections. The patterned bowl rests on a wooden table, warmly lit.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches under soft lighting.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior, green patterned rim with red floral motifs, and a glossy, smooth surface.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, creamy yellow-orange, with visible noodles, herbs, and toppings, showing rich texture and surface details.
regions.spoon: A white plastic spoon with a smooth, slightly textured surface and rounded bowl shape.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellow-white, smooth surface with faint dark speckles, oval shape, resting in broth.
